reminder.body:
Dear {name},

This is a reminder that the signed copy of the document "{title}" (No. {number}) has not been handed in yet.
The document is available here:
{link}

Please print the document, sign it by hand next to the ☐ box and hand it to your coordinator by {expires}.

Kind regards,
{academy}
